UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$bot='{{$FullInstanceDir}}/jupiter-bot'; if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $bot 'Bot.exe'))) { exit 0 }; $mark='JUPITER_BOT_' + 'WAIT'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -like ('*' + $mark + '*') } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Bot.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*Config.ini*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $port={{$ServerPort}}; $cmd='$env:' + $mark + '=''1''; $port=' + $port + '; $bot=''' + $bot + '''; foreach ($n in 1..180) { try { $c=New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect(''127.0.0.1'',$port); $c.Close(); break } catch { Start-Sleep 1 } }; Set-Location $bot; & (Join-Path $bot ''Bot.exe'') -config Config.ini -pluginsdir Plugins -configsdir Configs *>> (Join-Path $bot ''bot.log'')'; Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden powershell.exe -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-Command',$cmd; Write-Output ('Jupiter Bot will connect to 127.0.0.1:' + $port + ' when Renegade X is listening. Log: ' + $bot + '/bot.log')"
